properties.name: Consolidate reflow2-core's 225 test files into 4 test programs
properties.rationale: Anthony's decision dec:rocksdb-is-a-default-on-feature-of-the-server-crate-and-its-tests-share-a-few-programs names consolidating tests into a few programs. Each standalone file was its own binary, costing ~22 MB of linker output apiece; as modules of one program they share the binary and link once. No shared mutable state found except the_schema_is_parsed_once (LazyLock cold path), which stays isolated. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: reflow2-core's 225 integration test files consolidated into 4 test programs: in_memory (223 files as modules), on_disk (1), on_disk_fulltext (1), the_schema_is_parsed_once (1 isolated for LazyLock cold path). Test discovery off; guard test fails on any missing file. Build artifact size ~4.9 GB to ~100 MB (no features). 1909 tests before = 1909 after + 3 guard tests. AGENTS.md updated: --test heal becomes --test in_memory heal::.
